categories.main_business_segments: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (MSGS) operates as a single business segment focused on owning and operating professional sports franchises. Its primary assets are the New York Knicks (NBA), New York Rangers (NHL), and their respective development league affiliates: the Westchester Knicks (NBA G League) and Hartford Wolf Pack (AHL). The company also owns and operates the Madison Square Garden Training Center.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: MSGS's core operations revolve around team management, player development, and event production for live sports. The company utilizes advanced training facilities, performance analytics, and state-of-the-art event presentation methods at Madison Square Garden. It leverages digital ticketing, dynamic pricing, and integrated media production for both in-person and broadcast audiences.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves sports fans in the New York metropolitan area, corporate clients (through suites and sponsorships), and media partners. Its key markets are NBA and NHL fans, local and national advertisers, and corporate hospitality clients seeking premium experiences at Madison Square Garden events.
categories.geographic_coverage: MSGS's operations and revenues are almost entirely concentrated in the United States, with a primary focus on the New York City metropolitan area. The company’s teams have global brand recognition, but the bulk of its business activities and assets are located in New York.
categories.supply_chain_position: MSGS operates at the downstream end of the sports and entertainment supply chain, directly engaging with consumers, corporate partners, and media distributors. It is responsible for the final delivery of live sports content, ticketed events, and related experiences.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategy centers on maximizing the value of its iconic sports franchises by developing championship-caliber teams, enhancing the fan experience, and leveraging its position in the nation’s largest media market. MSGS invests in player development, innovative event presentation, digital fan engagement, and integrated sponsorship platforms. It also focuses on long-term media rights agreements and premium hospitality offerings.
categories.revenue_model: MSGS generates revenue from multiple streams: ticket sales (season, group, and single-game), suite and club licenses, local and national media rights, sponsorships and signage, food and beverage sales, and merchandise. Many of these revenues are secured through multi-year contracts, providing recurring income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MSGS faces intense competition from other New York area sports teams (Yankees, Mets, Giants, Jets, Islanders, Devils, Nets, etc.), as well as from other entertainment options in the region. Within the NBA and NHL, the Knicks and Rangers compete for fan attention, player talent, and media exposure. MSGS is positioned as a premier sports brand with deep local roots and global recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, MSGS reported revenues of approximately $1.03 billion, with net income of $58.8 million. The company experienced 16% year-over-year revenue growth, driven by strong team performance and increased playoff games. MSGS maintains a significant asset base and recurring revenue streams, with a market capitalization of around $3.4 billion as of December 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MSGS offers unique access to two of the most storied franchises in professional sports, delivering premium live experiences at Madison Square Garden, 'The World’s Most Famous Arena.' The company differentiates itself through iconic brands, a passionate fan base, integrated sports and entertainment offerings, and its central role in the New York market. Its long-term media and sponsorship agreements, combined with a focus on fan engagement and premium hospitality, create a compelling value proposition for fans, partners, and advertisers.
